parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of pickling query objects with values()/values_list() by ensuring the correct iterable class and fields are set upon unpickling. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces new attributes and methods in Query and QuerySet classes without aligning with the existing naming conventions and style of the Django codebase.
